fixed.summary: The first frame that shows a kind of streamed model no longer stops to compile its pipelines (42 ms of a first cell's load frame on a desktop Vulkan GPU): while a fade is at nothing its model is not drawn and its pipelines compile on worker threads, and the frames start the fade once they are made, usually at once. A model with its fade turned off (seconds 0) draws whole on its first frame and compiles there, as before. Captures, world state and hashes are unchanged.
